evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth from ~6 to 33 ppm after stable ~5 ppm through ramp
Ar flow steady at setpoint 100 sccm, so rise is not from purge gas change
Temperature holding 750 °C at setpoint with normal heater power

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2 trend (whether it keeps climbing), pressure response, and a leak-check/Ar-flow-step test to distinguish a seal leak from an O2 sensor drift
